The FloPlast 110mm solvent weld double socket short pipe is a robust uPVC drainage boss pipe designed for efficient waste management in soil and vent systems. It is ideal for plumbers and drainage specialists requiring multiple connections in compact spaces, such as connecting bathroom, kitchen, or utility room waste pipes to a soil stack. This grey pipe features three boss inlets, accommodating 32mm and 40mm waste pipes, ensuring versatile connections. Its lightweight uPVC construction offers excellent strength and durability, handling high-temperature waste discharges effectively. The solvent weld system facilitates secure and leak-free joints, while using silicone lubricant aids installation.
